result.area_summary: scqo/experiments/ never imports roster.py/categories.py/config.py/physical.py directly. All old-model coupling flows through exactly three surfaces: (1) ClassVars consumed by Session pre-probe validation — target_category (category name string; only pair_zz_coupler overrides the "ReadableTransmon" default declared in scqo/experiment.py:43), required_operations (op-name tuples "rx"/"readout"/"flux_bias"/"coupler_bias"), flux_component_categories (category-name tuple), attach_readout_positions (drives experiment.py's readout_pos_* monitor reads); (2) self.device.component(name) attribute get/set plus self.device.one(name, category) two-slot satellite lookups ("Resonator"/"ZControl"/"ReadoutLine"); (3) self.anchor(name, field) design-fallback reads. Complete field write inventory and new homes per the greenfield doc: KNOBS — readout_freq -> <q>_ro.readout_freq_hz (resonator_spectroscopy, resonator_spectroscopy_flux, readout_frequency, both punchouts); readout_amp -> <q>_ro.readout_amp (readout_power); readout_power_dbm -> <q>_ro.readout_power_dbm (both punchouts, boundary set/revert); drive_freq -> <q>_xy.drive_freq_hz (qubit_spectroscopy, qubit_ramsey); drive_power_dbm -> <q>_xy.drive_power_dbm (_drive_power.py boundary); pi_amp -> <q>_xy.pi_amp (qubit_power_rabi, qubit_pi_pulse_error); drag_beta -> <q>_xy.drag_beta (both DRAG experiments); idle_flux_v -> <q>_z.idle_flux (resonator_spectroscopy_flux); coupler_decouple_v -> the pair's coupler flux channel idle_flux, i.e. <coupler>_z.idle_flux (pair_zz_coupler). MONITORS — readout_fidelity is BANNED as an aggregate (doc §6 notes): must become fidelity_g/fidelity_e on <q>_ro; readout_pos_{g,e}_{i,q} -> pos_{g,e}_{i,q} on <q>_ro (single_shot_readout, plus the ref_pos attach in experiment.py). FACTS — f_01_hz/t1_s/t2_star_s/t2_echo_s/ej_sum_hz/f_q_max_hz stay on the mode (names unchanged); f_r_hz/kappa_tot_hz/f_r0_hz stay on <q>_res; g_hz RE-HOMES from ReadoutLine to <q>_res (boundary rule: the resonator owns its g); v_offset_v/v_per_phi0_v -> <q>_z.flux_offset/<q>_z.flux_per_phi0 (source-native, no _v suffix); zz_hz stays on the qubit_pair composite. Targeting-shape changes: pair_zz_coupler (composite target; its single view.coupler_decouple_v+zz_hz write splits into a channel knob on a THIRD entity resolved via the pair's coupler ref, plus a composite fact); resonator_spectroscopy_flux and qubit_spectroscopy_flux_pulse (FluxComponentParameters foreign-source assignment loses its category-based narrowing vocabulary; their update() now spans up to four entities: q, q_res, q_z, q_ro). The state_readout capability, _sim.py, qubit_sqrb, qubit_tomography, qubit_relaxation_flux and qubit_echo_flux touch no device fields (record-only / no update()) — only ClassVar validation plumbing and, for the flux pair, the FluxSweepParameters naming question.

result.area_summary: Both drivers consume the old model through an identical four-part glue pattern: (1) a pure-data fieldmap module (VendorBinding/Unrealized/VendorOnly tables keyed by CATEGORY name "ReadableTransmon"/"TransmonPair"), (2) a backend module whose view classes subclass scqo.device.make_view_base(category) and whose DeviceModel serves .component(name)/.components()/.snapshot() keyed by QUBIT name, (3) probe wrappers that read neutral fields off backend.device.component(target) using old spellings (readout_freq, drive_freq, pi_amp, idle_flux_v, coupler_decouple_v), and (4) a test_scqo_glue.py drift test asserting bindings|unrealized == scqo.categories.pushed_fields(category) plus an inline old-schema components.toml fixture. Under the greenfield model the one-qubit-view lump splits into channel entities: on QM, q1_xy maps to QUAM q.xy (+ the f_01 dual-write), q1_ro to q.resonator, q1_z to q.z (flux_point-selected offset), the coupler flux channel q1_q2_c_z to machine.qubit_pairs[pair].coupler (QUAM has no standalone coupler qubit), and composite q1_q2 knobs to qp.coupler offsets/macros; on Qblox, q1_xy maps to the element clock "q1.01" (rxy + lab spec submodule; hardware_options port-clock "q1:mw-q1.01"), q1_ro to clock "q1.ro" (measure submodule; port-clock "q1:res-q1.ro"), and q1_z has no realization yet (today an Unrealized entry; a flux port-clock lands with the first flux chip). Config-folder conventions (QM: <cid>/<setup>/backend_config/state.json+wiring.json; Qblox: dut_config.json+hw_config.json) are preserved by design, but nothing in either folder is currently keyed by roster LINE names — wiring.json keys per-qubit rr/xy/z opx_output port refs and hw_config keys port-clock strings — so the line-name join and the doctor witnesses (a)-(d) need a new annotation artifact. State seeding (state_sync="pull") flows through DeviceModel.snapshot(), whose per-qubit field lists must become per-channel-entity keys (q1_xy/q1_ro/q1_z, plus q1_q2 composite knobs on QM). Target naming: params.targets carry roster names joined verbatim to machine.qubits[name] / QuantumDevice.get_element(name) — preserved for modes, but the QM composite join (roster q1_q2 vs QUAM pair id "q1-2") is currently bridged ad hoc in pair_zz_coupler and must be restated.
result.design_questions: 1) Fieldmap successor shape: the schema fixes per-channel-kind field catalogs in core (section 6) but says nothing about the driver-declared VendorBinding/Unrealized/VendorOnly tables — do they re-key by channel KIND (drive/readout/flux/pump), by entity, or per (channel kind x target kind) row? And what replaces pushed_fields(category) as the drift-test anchor (presumably the knob column of the section 7 table)? 2) Where do composite per-operation knob bindings live — iswap_coupler_flux has no home in either fieldmap concept today, and coupler_interaction_v's realizer (qp.coupler.interaction_offset) must move under an operation-scoped binding; how is push of operation-scoped knobs declared? 3) Does make_view_base/DeviceModel.component survive with channel entities as the view unit, and is the q1.pi_amp default-addressing sugar (section 7) resolved in core — letting probes keep component(target).field reads — or must drivers serve channel-named components (component("q1_ro"))? 4) Coupler-as-mode mapping: greenfield makes q1_q2_c an ordinary flux_transmon with its own q1_q2_c_z channel, but QUAM realizes the coupler only as qubit_pairs[pair].coupler — what is the sanctioned channel-to-vendor mapping, incl. a coupler serving two pairs? 5) The line-name join: what concrete artifact in each vendor config folder carries the roster-line -> vendor-port annotation the doctor witnesses key on (wiring.json port refs / hw_config port-clock keys carry no line names today)? 6) Composite naming join: must the QUAM pair id be renamed to the roster composite name (q1_q2 vs today's "q1-2"), or is a declared mapping allowed (the sample-owns-names rule argues rename)? 7) Does the Unrealized concept survive? Capability-by-construction removes the Qblox idle_flux_v case (no flux rider, no channel), but drag_beta/readout_rotation_rad/readout_threshold are drive/readout-catalog fields the Qblox backend still cannot realize — the schema doc never restates the declared-unrealized mechanism the drift tests depend on. 8) Seeding: is snapshot() still the pull-mode seed surface, now keyed by channel entities, and how does a vendor report absence (entity exists in roster, no vendor element) vs unset?
